Record source-library log-length and measurement rules

Source: R/stem-nsvb.R
nvel_rules.Rd

Record source-library log-length and measurement rules

Usage

nvel_rules(
  even_or_odd = NA_integer_,
  option = NA_integer_,
  maximum_length = NA_real_,
  minimum_length = NA_real_,
  minimum_top_length = NA_real_,
  merchantable_length = NA_real_,
  primary_top = NA_real_,
  secondary_top = NA_real_,
  stump = NA_real_,
  trim = NA_real_,
  bark_ratio = NA_real_,
  minimum_board_foot_dbh = NA_real_,
  scribner = 'regional',
  prod = '01',
  ht_type = '',
  live = 'L',
  ctype = 'C',
  cull = 0,
  forest = 0,
  district = 0
)

Arguments

even_or_odd

Choose the source library's log-length rounding convention. Numeric whole- number code, unitless, default NA selects the library default. Code 1 allows odd lengths and code 2 uses even lengths.

option

Choose how the source library divides the merchantable stem. Numeric whole- number code, unitless, default NA selects the library default. Codes 11 through 14 use its 16, 20, 32, and 40 foot conventions. Codes 21 through 24 select its top-segment rules.

maximum_length

Set the longest nominal segment allowed by the source rules. Numeric, feet, default NA selects the library default.

minimum_length

Set the shortest nominal segment allowed by the source rules. Numeric, feet, default NA selects the library default.

minimum_top_length

Set the shortest top segment allowed by the source rules. Numeric, feet, default NA selects the library default.

merchantable_length

Set the primary-product stem length needed for the tree to qualify. Numeric, feet, default NA selects the library default.

primary_top

Set the smallest inside-bark diameter for the primary product. Numeric, inches, default NA selects the library default.

secondary_top

Set the smallest inside-bark diameter for the secondary product. Numeric, inches, default NA selects the library default.

stump

Set the height left below the first source-library segment. Numeric, feet, default NA selects the library default.

trim

Set the extra wood cut above each nominal source-library segment. Numeric, feet, default NA selects the library default.

bark_ratio

The bark ratio estimates inside diameter from outside diameter when needed. Numeric scalar, inside diameter divided by outside diameter. Default: NA_real_.

minimum_board_foot_dbh

Set the smallest tree eligible for board foot volume. Numeric outside-bark diameter at breast height, inches, default NA selects the library default.

scribner

Choose how the source library scales Scribner volume. Character vector, unitless, default 'regional' uses its regional setting. 'table' uses the Scribner table and 'factor' uses regional factors. Missing values and unknown labels are errors.

prod

Choose the source product class. Character vector of two-character codes, unitless, default '01' means sawtimber. '08' means a nonsaw product.

ht_type

Tell the source library how height is recorded. Character vector, unitless, default '' leaves the setting unspecified. 'F' means feet and 'L' means logs.

live

Tell the source library whether the tree is alive. Character vector, unitless, default 'L' means live. 'D' means dead.

ctype

Identify the kind of inventory supplying the tree. Character vector, unitless, default 'C' means cruise. 'I' selects Forest Inventory and Analysis, 'F' selects Forest Vegetation Simulator, and 'B' selects the alternate National Scale Volume and Biomass route. Missing values and unknown labels are errors.

cull

Supply the whole-tree cull percentage required by a source equation. Numeric, percent, default 0. This source input does not reduce merchandise log scales.

forest

The national forest code selects local source rules. Numeric vector, whole-number forest codes. Default: 0.

district

The ranger district code selects local source rules. Numeric vector, whole-number district codes. Default: 0.

Value

A validated list with class treevolume_nvel_rules. Input vectors are preserved for common-size recycling by the consuming calculation.

Examples

## Inspect an explicit whole foot source rule record.
nvel_rules(even_or_odd = 1,
           maximum_length = 32,
           minimum_length = 16,
           primary_top = 6)
#> $even_or_odd
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $option
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $maximum_length
#> [1] 32
#> 
#> $minimum_length
#> [1] 16
#> 
#> $minimum_top_length
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $merchantable_length
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $primary_top
#> [1] 6
#> 
#> $secondary_top
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $stump
#> [1] NA
#>

#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $bark_ratio
#> [1] NA
#>

#> [1] NA
#>

#> 
#> $prod

#>
